_about: Crownhold character identity register (art bible v0.4, PROPOSED). The ONLY editable source of each character's head, weapon or prop, stance and constraints. state/skyglass_art/build_art_batch.py renders the officer briefs (#8-#26) and Arakane's prerequisite brief from it. Live usernames live in push/crownhold.gen.py USERNAME; batch numbers and delivery files are fixed here and must not change.
source: Art director handoff 2026-10-26 (HANDOFF - GHOST SHIP / SKYGLASS ART BIBLE v0.4), reserved head + weapon/prop + stance per character.

characters.title: Armsmaster
characters.head: an asymmetric, shallow, notched iron jingasa over a cloth mask
characters.weapon_or_prop: ONE broad curved short-handled ono war-axe
characters.stance: tall, a controlled diagonal axe strike

characters.title: Trialmaster
characters.head: a flat tenugui headwrap tied in a square knot at the back
characters.weapon_or_prop: a single long bokken

characters.title: Tagwright
characters.head: a squared, short-peaked, soot-dark hood
characters.weapon_or_prop: three broad paper explosive tags held in a throwing fan

characters.title: Lancer
characters.head: a fitted ridged cap with a short rear flap
characters.weapon_or_prop: a long fork-headed yari thrust horizontally
constraints: not an upright spear held at rest

characters.title: Duelist
characters.head: a diagonally tied tenugui with one rear cloth fold
characters.weapon_or_prop: a slim single drawn tachi

characters.title: Replicant Zero
characters.head: a close medical coif framed by a raised collar
characters.weapon_or_prop: hand-forged surgical forceps; a medic's scroll case at the waist
characters.stance: examining his own complete, solid left hand
constraints: the left hand is whole and solid

characters.title: Archivist
characters.head: a compact, square-folded cloth eboshi
characters.weapon_or_prop: an open V-shaped bound ledger
characters.stance: a guarded sideways stance, ink-stained gloves

characters.title: Binder
characters.head: a deep asymmetric hood with a long folded side panel
characters.weapon_or_prop: a large three-toothed iron sealing key

characters.title: Echo
characters.head: a split-topped hood with two unequal peaks
characters.weapon_or_prop: a single three-pronged iron sai
constraints: the instability shows only as haze at the cloth edges
no clone, no double image, no glitch

characters.title: Stonebound
characters.head: a sloping brow-wrap with one rough earth plate
characters.weapon_or_prop: a short spiked iron tetsubo
constraints: compact earth armour on one arm and shoulder only

characters.title: The Second
characters.head: a wide, nearly flat woven kasa over a cloth mask, a short grey beard below
characters.weapon_or_prop: an unsheathed straight shikomi-zue blade
characters.stance: tall and defensive, the blade low and outward

characters.title: Signaller
characters.head: a side-folded hood with a triangular ear flap
characters.weapon_or_prop: a large oval gunbai war fan; a small nobori flag on the back
characters.stance: directing a troop movement with an extended arm

characters.title: Tactician
characters.head: a narrow, tall, three-fold angled cloth cap
characters.weapon_or_prop: a black-iron jitte with its side prong visible; a small campaign map case at the waist

characters.title: Honor Guard
characters.head: a fitted hood beneath a triangular iron brow visor
characters.weapon_or_prop: a long broad-bladed naginata

characters.title: Runner
characters.head: a tight wrap with two short ties streaming behind
characters.weapon_or_prop: a single iron kunai held forward; two bamboo dispatch tubes high on the back

characters.title: Vanguard
characters.head: a low angular iron fighting hood with a notched brow
characters.weapon_or_prop: a short-handled iron fire-hook
constraints: a few contained ember pixels at the hook only

characters.title: Herald
characters.head: a tall, forward-bent cloth eboshi
characters.weapon_or_prop: a vertical decree scroll in one hand and a short tanto in the other

characters.title: Last Watch
characters.head: a deep crescent night hood with uneven corners
characters.weapon_or_prop: ONE kusarigama with a physical short chain and weight
characters.stance: a low predatory stance, one controlled chain arc

characters.title: Sealbearer
characters.head: a rigid box-shaped cowl with a rectangular brow tab
characters.weapon_or_prop: an upright rectangular blackwood command-seal tablet
characters.stance: holding the tablet forward, the other hand ready to seal

characters.title: Supreme Commander Arakane
characters.head: a plain dark hood, a severe iron half-mask, and the Command Crown described below
characters.weapon_or_prop: a single broad black-iron nagamaki
characters.stance: the tallest of all, lean and commanding, the blade held horizontal
constraints: outranks the Crowned Captain through disciplined seven-blade geometry and posture, not size or decoration
the crown reads as one powerful head silhouette at 125 px

crown.lock: The Command Crown: a thin CLOSED ring of blackened iron with seven blunt iron seal notches and one small faceted pale cyan seal stone at the front; above it, with a small gap, seven separate floating skyglass blades: one central upright blade, a pair of inner diagonals, a pair of outer diagonals and two shorter flanking blades; the crystal blades outlined dark and cel shaded in two or three steps.
crown.forbid: no gold, no glowing strings or threads, no extra crystal debris, no jewels, no giant light halo, no radiant ghost body, no ornate armour
crown.exclusive: Arakane only; the Crowned Captain is unchanged
